items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So he was driving and Bob was the pianist, he came up with the lady

ctx.x: Was he your bus driver for the whole time?

Most of the time, most of the time. Kooky guy. So he was driving and Bob was the pianist, he came up with the lady and she’s got her hat and she said, “I’m getting out.” And I said, “You can’t get out” and Bob Bates said, “You want to get out, then get out.” he stopped the bus and opened the door!
You’re in the middle of Canada somewhere?
